release_notes: Added persistent Adhan volume control with adjustable volume from 0% to 100%
Added synchronized Adhan volume handling across Windows and Android
Added persistent volume settings that survive application restart
Improved Android background Adhan playback using the system alarm audio channel
Improved Adhan notification sound isolation to prevent unwanted system notification sounds
Improved Adhan playback lifecycle to prevent preview audio from interfering with background Adhan playback
Improved reciter selection and preview handling with automatic preview cleanup
Improved background Adhan reliability across Windows and Android
Hardened Android Adhan volume persistence and native audio preference handling
Improved overall audio management, stability, and cross-platform prayer experience
